title: mindmap breaking issue in ELK layout
body:

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.label_reasoning: The comment warns about a potential undefined dereference on `nodeDb[node.id]` after the assignment was removed, which would cause a TypeError at runtime.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment identifies a potential runtime TypeError and provides a concrete code suggestion to guard against undefined access.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: Duplicate HTML element ID 'diagram4' used multiple times (lines 132, 141, 150). HTML IDs must be unique within a document to ensure proper element identification and functionality.
comments.label_reasoning: Duplicate HTML element IDs violate HTML spec and can cause incorrect behavior when elements are selected by ID, making it a logic/semantic correctness issue in the test fixture.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment flags a violation (duplicate HTML IDs) that should be fixed to ensure unique IDs within the document.
